requirements.title: Introduction to University Scholars
requirements.sourceText: Students must satisfactorily complete first-year foundational courses (SCH 101 and SCH 102) ... Receive an “S” (Satisfactory) grade in their SCH 101 course

requirements.title: Scholars courses
requirements.sourceText: First Year SCH 101 and 102; Second and Third Years SCH 200 and 300; Fourth Year SCH 490. The Scholars Senior Capstone (SCH 490) is the culminating academic requirement in the program.

requirements.title: EXP+ requirement
requirements.sourceText: Students must satisfactorily complete ... the EXP+ requirement

rule.reason: Any course carrying EXP+ satisfies it; the SBC checklist tracks EXP+.

requirements.title: Co-curricular engagement
requirements.sourceText: First-semester Scholars are required to participate in two co-curricular engagement activities during their first term in the program; in each subsequent semester, they must participate in at least one.

rule.text: Two co-curricular engagement activities in the first semester, then at least one each semester
rule.reason: Engagement activities don't appear on a transcript.

policies.sourceText: a C or better in all required SCH courses

notes.text: To stay in University Scholars and receive the transcript notation: an S in SCH 101, a C or better in all required SCH courses, a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0, and the engagement minimum each semester.
These are the requirements for students entering in Fall 2025 or later. Students who entered earlier complete SCH 101, SCH 102, the EXP+ requirement, and engagement requirements only.
